column1: # Executable documentation of intentionally unsupported shapes
# These ALLOW results do not classify the action as safe. They keep the
# enumerated registry grammar, the bounded token walk, and their current gaps
# The custom visibility rule walks intervening tokens with a bounded class that
# stops at a shell metacharacter, quoted or not. The built-in rule crosses a
# quoted one but treats any --help token as a safe pattern. Only the
# combination escapes both: a quoted metacharacter argument and a --help value.
# The plain quoted-metacharacter shape is a DENY in worktree_isolated.tsv.
